traits.name:
Healer - +2 to all rolls to diagnose, treat, and heal; +3 to First Aid specifically; HT rolls
to avoid or recover from disease at +2.
Charity - Cannot ignore genuine need. Must roll vs. 12 or help anyone who asks for assistance you can reasonably provide. May be exploited.
Sense of Duty (Flock) - Must help/protect certain groups even at personal risk

Clueless −3 to all social skill rolls; generally miss social cues and subtlety. You do
not understand subtext, sarcasm, or implication

Sanctity - Your connection to the divine is unusually clear. +2 to Theology and
Religious Ritual; once per session, the GM must answer one factual
question about Church doctrine or history honestly.

Clueless −3 to all social skill rolls; generally miss social cues and subtlety. You do
not understand subtext, sarcasm, or implication.
Blacklisted: Specific Industry org or church
